title: Variance and distance to constants
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on a sign cube, and let $d$ be its minimum relative Hamming distance to either constant function $+1$ or constant function $-1$. Then $2d\le \operatorname{Var}(f)\le 4d$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on a sign cube
